patch_description: This candidate crosses the stronger parts of the two prior designs: it keeps the parity-symmetric RX/RY pre/post structure and ring CZ entanglement from the best 50-parameter model, then injects the current model’s long-range controlled-rotation bottleneck to increase nonlocal expressivity without inflating the parameter count too much. The result is a compact 10-parameter-per-block ansatz (62 total parameters) that should preserve the good generalization of the simpler model while recovering some of the long-range interaction power from the larger one.
